info.title: PoolRotater M4 ratings extension
info.description: Explicit migrated hub, dedicated scoped host network credentials. Immutable capture, canonical state and verified aggregate snapshots. No provider credentials or remote admin.

post.description: Up to500 immutable events, 512KiB uncompressed JSON. Per-event durable acknowledgment, independent of batch ID. Authentication requires ratings-submit; observe-only quarantines. A malformed event does not block later events. Accepted means durable ingestion, not aggregate inclusion.

200.description: Bounded outcomes indexed to submitted events; event_id/phase/reason/revision/watermark; processing_watermark; aggregate_inclusion_confirmed:false

503.description: Storage/migration unavailable; retry same event IDs

post.description: Up to100 event IDs already handled for this host. Resolves only their player/map keys. Unknown or foreign event IDs return known:false, not arbitrary voter enumeration. ratings-query is granted only to contributing hosts. 64KiB request bound.

200.description: Per-event known state, revision/rating/suppression for permitted keys

post.description: Authenticated ratings-query scope, closed previous_host_id. Returns same-stream high-water and exact epoch/identity. Replacement replay requires an explicit root-local link to a revoked matching operator/account/installation/generation. No remote lineage administration.

get.description: Current complete canonical manifest. Requires ratings-read. Up to100000 maps and200 pages. Watermarks are processing and policy floors, not upload confirmations.
Immutable verified page. Requires ratings-read. Exact content_id SHA256 and index query parameters. Up to500 sorted maps and512KiB. Unknown/pruned versions require refetching current manifest.

networkBearer.description: M3 host network credential with explicit M4 scopes, never an osu! OAuth token.
